name: synthetic-chinese-blog-retrieval
source: Project-generated synthetic Chinese technical documents with fixed reference relevance/evidence labels; no production export or independent expert annotation
scope: Public capability and ranking regression only; not a production quality score, blind holdout or public benchmark leaderboard. dev includes previously exercised cases and alias examples; test is separately authored and frozen before this implementation is evaluated.

splits.dev: Known development and existing source-contract examples; may be used to tune.
splits.test: Public project-generated evaluation questions with fixed reference labels, without independent human validation; not a secret or independently authored holdout. Once used to tune retrieval, rotate the independent acceptance set.
